Upcoming Film 'Ramayana' Tops IMDb's Most Anticipated List

The upcoming film 'Ramayana' has been named IMDb's most anticipated film for 2026, surpassing other notable releases. This ranking indicates significant fan excitement for the project. The film's popularity on the list has overshadowed other highly awaited movies, including those featuring prominent actors.
